title: DR1 tells the user on What are you importing? that a consignment needing no health certificate must still be notified; the frontend's inset text drops that sentence.

controls.text: Each health certificate requires a separate notification.
A separate notification is required for each health certificate. Consignments that do not require a health certificate must still be notified.

finding.frontend: The inset text above the species list reads, in full, 'Each health certificate requires a separate notification.' (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/copy/copy.en.js:6, rendered at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/search/search.njk:12-14). A user whose consignment needs no health certificate is told nothing about whether they still have to notify it, and this is the only page in the journey where the question comes up.
finding.prototype: DR1's inset carries two sentences: 'A separate notification is required for each health certificate. Consignments that do not require a health certificate must still be notified.' (app/views/what-are-you-importing.html:41-44). The second sentence is the one that answers a user's likely reason for abandoning the journey here.
finding.difference: Add the second sentence to the inset copy on What are you importing?, and take DR1's wording for the first — 'A separate notification is required for each health certificate' rather than the frontend's inversion of it. One copy string, in the commodities feature's copy file, in English and Welsh.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding the no-certificate rule stated anywhere else the user meets before choosing a commodity.
